title_en: What strike on Russian ship in Libya says about spread of Ukraine war
title_zh: 俄罗斯船只在利比亚遭到袭击说明乌克兰战争蔓延
summary: Ukraine's sinking of a Russian battleship at a port in Libya raises the stakes of the war a notch, writes Frank Gardner.
summary_zh: 弗兰克·加德纳写道，乌克兰在利比亚港口击沉一艘俄罗斯战舰，使战争的风险上升了一个档次。
body_en: Anchored in a Mediterranean harbour nearly 2,000 miles from Moscow, the Captain of Russia's corvette Merkury might well have thought his ship was safe from attack. It wasn't.

The audacious and successful night-time attack in Benghazi , co-ordinated by Ukraine's SBU intelligence agency and its armed forces, has raised the obvious question: is the Ukraine war spreading well beyond its borders?
The answer is yes, in fact, it was already spreading. But this attack, which Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelensky called "an exemplary operation" will inevitably raise the stakes another notch.
Russia, which is currently engaged in a non-stop campaign to batter Ukraine's civilian population into submission with daily missile and drone strikes , has called it "a dangerous escalation".
It follows the suspected Ukrainian drone attack on a Russian dry-cargo ship in the Gulf of Finland at the weekend, which the Kremlin described as an act of terrorism.
Ukraine's long-range drones have also previously struck Russia's Baltic oil terminal at Ust-Luga.

Some of Ukraine's more audacious long-range drone attacks – what Zelensky likes to call "long-range sanctions" – have also struck targets thousands of kilometres beyond Ukraine's borders with Russia, deep inside Siberia.

The most notable of these was last year's Operation Spider's Web, which involved a specially adapted lorry that drove close to a Russian strategic nuclear bomber airbase and released a "swarm" of explosive drones that damaged or destroyed several expensive bombers.

And Ukraine has also been active further south in Africa where its forces have targeted Russian mercenaries from the Africa Corps, the successor to the infamous Wagner Group that was accused of carrying out numerous human rights abuses.
It's not just Russia that will be alarmed by this latest Ukrainian operation in Benghazi harbour. The United Nations mission in Libya has already expressed its "deep concern".

Libyan officials point out that their country is not a party to the Russia-Ukraine war, although the Merkury and an accompanying cargo ship that was also hit were berthed in the eastern part of Libya controlled by the pro-Moscow warlord and self-styled "Field Marshal" Khalifa Haftar.

Throughout this year the International Maritime Organisation (IMO) has condemned all attacks on commercial shipping in the Strait of Hormuz and today the global shipping community will be wondering whether this attack does indeed set a dangerous precedent.
If Ukraine can plan and execute such a bold attack on Russian ships in a nominally neutral harbour so far from home, where does this stop?
As the fifth anniversary of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine approaches, this war has already been spreading, notably in other parts of Europe.
On Friday, several Russian projectiles landed well inside Poland's borders , just 60 miles from an Anglo-French exercise of forces intended to be deployed following an eventual ceasefire in Ukraine.
This, said Poland's PM Donald Tusk, was "a deliberate provocation" by Moscow.

It's not the first time Russian munitions have landed inside Poland, and therefore inside Nato territory, but observers have pointed out that Russia's probing of Nato's borders is becoming ever more brazen and some are calling for a firmer response.

But Russia is already heavily sanctioned by the West, with Europe having reduced much – but not all – of its energy imports from Russia, so the options for retaliation are limited, short of military confrontation, which no one wants.

Both Romania and Moldova have found themselves frequently struck by overflying Russian drones targeting Ukraine's Black Sea ports, while Bulgaria and Romania have suffered maritime drone attacks on commercial shipping just offshore in the Black Sea.
In the case of Romania, a Nato member, fast jets have had to be scrambled to intercept incoming Russian drones and there is a profound suspicion that these incursions are not all accidental.
body_zh: 俄罗斯护卫舰“墨库里”号停泊在距莫斯科近 2,000 英里的地中海港口，船长很可能认为他的船不会受到攻击。事实并非如此。
在乌克兰 SBU 情报机构及其武装部队的协调下，班加西发生的大胆而成功的夜间袭击提出了一个明显的问题：乌克兰战争是否已经蔓延到其边界之外？
答案是肯定的，事实上，它已经在蔓延了。但这次被乌克兰总统泽连斯基称为“堪称典范的行动”的袭击将不可避免地使赌注再上一个台阶。
俄罗斯目前正在进行一场不间断的行动，通过每日导弹和无人机袭击来迫使乌克兰平民屈服，俄罗斯称这是“危险的升级”。
周末，乌克兰无人机疑似在芬兰湾袭击了一艘俄罗斯干货船，克里姆林宫将其描述为恐怖主义行为。
乌克兰的远程无人机此前还袭击了俄罗斯位于乌斯季卢加的波罗的海石油码头。
乌克兰的一些更大胆的远程无人机攻击 — — 泽连斯基喜欢称之为“远程制裁” — — 还袭击了距离乌克兰与俄罗斯边境数千公里、西伯利亚深处的目标。
其中最引人注目的是去年的“蜘蛛网行动”，其中涉及一辆经过特殊改造的卡车驶近俄罗斯战略核轰炸机空军基地，并释放了“一大群”爆炸性无人机，损坏或摧毁了几架昂贵的轰炸机。
乌克兰在非洲南部也很活跃，其军队瞄准了来自非洲军团的俄罗斯雇佣兵，该军团是臭名昭著的瓦格纳集团的继承者，该集团被指控实施了多次侵犯人权行为。
不仅仅是俄罗斯会对乌克兰在班加西港的最新行动感到震惊。联合国驻利比亚特派团已表达“深切关注”。
利比亚官员指出，利比亚不是俄罗斯-乌克兰战争的一方，尽管“水星”号和一艘同样被击中的随行货船停泊在亲莫斯科军阀、自封的“陆军元帅”哈利法·哈夫塔尔控制的利比亚东部地区。
今年以来，国际海事组织 (IMO) 一直谴责霍尔木兹海峡发生的所有针对商业航运的袭击，而今天，全球航运界将怀疑这次袭击是否确实开创了一个危险的先例。
如果乌克兰能够在远离家乡的名义上中立的港口策划并执行对俄罗斯船只的如此大胆的攻击，那么这会止于哪里呢？
随着俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰五周年的临近，这场战争已经蔓延开来，尤其是在欧洲其他地区。
周五，几枚俄罗斯炮弹落在波兰境内，距乌克兰最终停火后打算部署的英法军演仅 60 英里。
波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克表示，这是莫斯科的“蓄意挑衅”。
这并不是俄罗斯弹药第一次落入波兰境内，因此也落入北约境内，但观察人士指出，俄罗斯对北约边界的探测正变得越来越无耻，一些人呼吁俄罗斯做出更坚决的回应。
但俄罗斯已经受到西方的严厉制裁，欧洲已经减少了大量（但不是全部）从俄罗斯的能源进口，因此报复的选择很有限，除了军事对抗之外，这是没有人想要的。
罗马尼亚和摩尔多瓦都经常遭到飞越乌克兰黑海港口的俄罗斯无人机袭击，而保加利亚和罗马尼亚则在黑海近海的商业航运上遭受海上无人机袭击。
就北约成员国罗马尼亚而言，必须紧急出动快速喷气式飞机拦截来袭的俄罗斯无人机，人们深刻怀疑这些入侵并非都是意外。

title_en: Israeli attacks have turned Gaza into 'toxic wasteland', Oxfam says
title_zh: 乐施会称以色列的袭击已将加沙变成“有毒荒地”
summary: The report says there are signs of possible contamination across almost all of Gaza as a result of Israel's actions.
summary_zh: 报告称，有迹象表明，由于以色列的行动，几乎整个加沙地带都可能受到污染。
body_en: Middle East correspondent , Reporting from Jerusalem

Gaza has been turned into "a toxic wasteland", with more than 99% of the Palestinian territory showing indicators of environmental contamination from Israeli military attacks, a new report from the charity Oxfam says , external .
Heavy metals, explosive residues, asbestos from destroyed buildings, and dioxins and biological contaminants are threats to Palestinians now and potentially for decades to come, it says.
Oxfam International's executive director, Amitabh Behar, said the impact on Gaza "will have fundamentally degraded the environmental conditions necessary for human safety and survival".
In response, the Israeli embassy in the UK said the report "falls short of professional standards".
Behar also accused Israel of "environmental war crimes" as part of an "ongoing genocide in Gaza".

Israel has rejected genocide accusations in an ongoing case at the International Court of Justice as baseless and distorted. It maintains that its military campaign in Gaza is an act of self-defence against Hamas in response to the group's deadly attack on Israel on 7 October 2023, and that it takes steps to mitigate civilian harm.

Oxfam and the UK-based Conflict and Environment Observatory (CEOBS) used satellite imagery, remote sensing, spatial analysis and other open-source data to draw their conclusions in the most comprehensive report to date on the severe environmental impacts caused by three years of intense war in Gaza.

The report details how munitions used in Israel's intense bombardment, as well as the debris from destroyed buildings and infrastructure, all have an impact on the environment. In February, a UN special rapporteur stated that more than 200,000 tonnes of explosives were dropped on Gaza in almost two years - "the equivalent of the total energy of approximately 13 Hiroshima-type nuclear bombs".

Last year, the UN Environment Programme (UNEP) estimated that Israel's military operations destroying homes and infrastructure had generated more than 61 million tonnes of debris across the territory, with about 15% potentially carrying a high risk of contamination from hazardous materials.
"There are going to be chronic health impacts that are long term because a lot of these contaminants are persistent in the environment," Oxfam report author Lama Abdul Samad told the BBC.
She says that now and in future Gazans are likely to suffer from increased respiratory diseases, cancers, organ damage and a rise in birth defects and stillbirths.

With all six wastewater treatment plants out of operation in Gaza, untreated sewage currently makes its way into groundwater and the Mediterranean Sea. The health impact has recently been exacerbated by heavy winter storms causing rainwater to mix with wastewater and flow through streets and tent sites housing displaced people.

Testing types and levels of contamination is often not possible because Gazan laboratories have been destroyed and there are Israeli restrictions on the entry of specialist testing equipment and scientists. The BBC has approached the Israeli military for comment.
UNEP said security concerns also prevented its expert staff from previously travelling to Gaza.

The Oxfam report calls for a full, independent environmental assessment to be carried out in Gaza to identify contamination risks ahead of a clean-up. It says special attention must be given to the protection of workers involved.

The Israeli embassy sharply criticised the report, arguing that it relied on satellite imagery "and unverified assumptions, and its methodology lacks the academic rigour needed to withstand serious scrutiny".
It said the report drew conclusions about Gaza's soil and groundwater without considering the excavation of hundreds of kilometres of tunnels by Hamas, rendering it fundamentally flawed.

Already, Gazan doctors have been reporting increased acute respiratory infections caused by dust and pollution from destroyed buildings and displaced people burning plastic, rags and cardboard to keep warm and cook food. Gastrointestinal diseases are linked to unsafe water and poor sanitation.

A Palestinian dermatologist, Dr Alaa Abu Hajar, told the BBC he had seen a five-fold increase in chronic skin diseases since the start of the war, putting this down to environmental pollution and overcrowded, unhygienic living conditions in tents and displacement camps.
body_zh: 中东记者，耶路撒冷报道
慈善机构乐施会对外发布的一份新报告称，加沙已变成“有毒荒地”，超过 99% 的巴勒斯坦领土都出现了以色列军事袭击造成的环境污染迹象。
报告称，重金属、爆炸物残留物、被毁建筑物产生的石棉、二恶英和生物污染物现在和未来几十年都对巴勒斯坦人构成威胁。
国际乐施会执行董事阿米塔布·贝哈尔表示，对加沙的影响“将从根本上恶化人类安全和生存所需的环境条件”。
以色列驻英国大使馆对此回应称，该报告“未达到专业标准”。
贝哈尔还指责以色列犯有“环境战争罪”，作为“加沙正在进行的种族灭绝”的一部分。
以色列驳回了国际法院正在审理的一起案件中的种族灭绝指控，称其毫无根据且歪曲事实。它坚称，其在加沙的军事行动是针对哈马斯的自卫行为，以回应该组织于 2023 年 10 月 7 日对以色列发动的致命袭击，并采取措施减轻平民伤害。
乐施会和英国冲突与环境观测站（CEOBS）利用卫星图像、遥感、空间分析和其他开源数据，就加沙三年激烈战争造成的严重环境影响，在迄今为止最全面的报告中得出结论。
该报告详细介绍了以色列猛烈轰炸中使用的弹药以及被毁建筑物和基础设施的碎片如何对环境产生影响。今年 2 月，联合国特别报告员表示，近两年内在加沙投放了超过 20 万吨炸药，“相当于大约 13 枚广岛型核弹的总能量”。
去年，联合国环境规划署 (UNEP) 估计，以色列摧毁房屋和基础设施的军事行动在全国范围内产生了超过 6100 万吨碎片，其中约 15% 可能存在受到有害材料污染的高风险。
乐施会报告作者拉马·阿卜杜勒·萨马德告诉英国广播公司：“这将对健康产生长期的慢性影响，因为许多污染物在环境中持久存在。”
她说，现在和将来，加沙人罹患呼吸道疾病、癌症、器官损伤的可能性可能会增加，出生缺陷和死产也会增加。
由于加沙所有六个废水处理厂均已停止运营，未经处理的污水目前进入地下水和地中海。最近，严重的冬季暴风雨导致雨水与废水混合并流经流离失所者居住的街道和帐篷营地，加剧了对健康的影响。
测试污染类型和水平通常是不可能的，因为加沙实验室已被摧毁，而且以色列对专业测试设备和科学家的入境有限制。 BBC已联系以色列军方征求评论。
环境署表示，安全问题也阻止了其专家人员此前前往加沙。
乐施会的报告呼吁在加沙进行全面、独立的环境评估，以便在清理之前识别污染风险。它说必须特别注意保护相关工人。
以色列大使馆严厉批评了这份报告，称其依赖于卫星图像“和未经证实的假设，其方法缺乏经受严格审查所需的学术严谨性”。
报告称，该报告对加沙土壤和地下水得出的结论没有考虑哈马斯挖掘数百公里隧道的情况，因此存在根本性缺陷。
加沙医生已经报告称，由于被毁建筑物的灰尘和污染以及流离失所者燃烧塑料、破布和纸板取暖和做饭而导致的急性呼吸道感染有所增加。胃肠道疾病与不安全的水和卫生条件差有关。
巴勒斯坦皮肤科医生阿拉·阿布·哈贾尔博士告诉英国广播公司，自战争开始以来，他发现慢性皮肤病增加了五倍，他将其归因于环境污染以及帐篷和流离失所者营地过度拥挤、不卫生的生活条件。

title_en: Nato chief vows defence against space threat after Russian nuclear satellite reports
title_zh: 俄罗斯核卫星报告后北约主席誓言防御太空威胁
summary: German media said Russia planned to launch a satellite with a nuclear warhead into space in coming weeks.
summary_zh: 德国媒体称，俄罗斯计划在未来几周内向太空发射一颗携带核弹头的卫星。
body_en: Nato chief Mark Rutte has said the alliance will defend against any threats in space after reports that Russia was preparing to launch a nuclear-armed satellite.

Intelligence reports about a possible launch in the next 60 days had been shared among Nato countries this month, according to German media outlets. It was not clear which country had authored the reports.
Asked about the reports, Rutte said: "We will always make sure we defend every inch of Nato territory, and that includes making sure we are safe when it comes to the space element."
Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said he hadn't seen the latest reports but dismissed reports citing "unknown sources" as "hardly worth taking seriously".
The Russian embassy in Berlin told German media it rejected what it called "unfounded allegations" and said the reports were part of a "propaganda campaign".
Rutte told the press conference in Berlin that Nato had a variety of response options.
"When it comes to the military domain, we will always make assessments of our deterrence and defence and make updates where necessary," he said.

Citing anonymous German military and intelligence sources, the reports by broadcasters NDR and WDR, and newspaper Sueddeutsche Zeitung, said the Russian satellite was dubbed "Sputnik-S" and was equipped with a nuclear warhead. It could be used to disrupt or destroy other satellites, including important communication and observation satellites.

Standing alongside Rutte, German Chancellor Friedrich Merz did not confirm or deny the reports of Russia's plans, but said they "reveal the level of escalation Russia is evidently prepared to pursue".
"Reports that Russia is planning to introduce nuclear weaponry into space are not new, yet they remain no less shocking," he said.

A German government spokesman earlier also did not confirm or deny the reports, but said it was taking the reports "very seriously", AFP reported. The spokesman, however, warned against causing "excessive nervousness regarding hypothetical dangers".
Josef Aschbacher, the head of the European Space Agency, said having nuclear weapons in space was "the ultimate nightmare scenario", German paper Handelsblatt reported.

Russia is a signatory to the 1967 Outer Space Treaty, which bans weapons of mass destruction from orbit. Other countries, including the US and China, have deployed or plan to deploy other weapons in space, exploring other capabilities outside of the treaty, such as targeting rivals' satellites - which are key for military communications, surveillance and navigation.
In 2024 the US claimed Russia was developing a "space-based" anti-satellite weapon armed with a nuclear warhead. Russia denied the accusation .
"Our position is clear and transparent. We have always been categorically against the deployment of nuclear weapons in space and we are still against it," President Vladimir Putin said at the time.

In September the US Secretary of the Air Force Troy Meink said the US had "on-orbit, space-control weapons" circling the planet, but did not provide specifics. In response to the announcement, the Kremlin's Peskov told Russian media that space "must be free of any weapon".

body_zh: 在有报道称俄罗斯准备发射核卫星后，北约主席马克·鲁特表示，北约将防御太空中的任何威胁。
据德国媒体报道，北约国家本月已分享有关未来 60 天内可能发射的情报报告。目前尚不清楚这些报告是哪个国家撰写的。
当被问及这些报道时，吕特说：“我们将始终确保保卫北约的每一寸领土，其中包括确保我们在太空方面的安全。”
克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫表示，他没有看到最新的报道，但驳斥了“来源不明”的报道，称其“不值得认真对待”。
俄罗斯驻柏林大使馆告诉德国媒体，它拒绝接受所谓的“毫无根据的指控”，并表示这些报道是“宣传活动”的一部分。
吕特在柏林举行的新闻发布会上表示，北约有多种应对方案。
他说：“在军事领域，我们将始终对我们的威慑和防御进行评估，并在必要时进行更新。”
NDR 和 WDR 广播公司以及南德意志报援引匿名的德国军方和情报来源的报道称，这颗俄罗斯卫星被称为“Sputnik-S”，并配备了核弹头。它可用于破坏或摧毁其他卫星，包括重要的通信和观测卫星。
德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨与吕特站在一起，没有证实或否认有关俄罗斯计划的报道，但表示这些报道“揭示了俄罗斯显然准备采取的升级程度”。
“有关俄罗斯计划将核武器引入太空的报道并不新鲜，但仍然令人震惊，”他说。
据法新社报道，德国政府发言人早些时候也没有证实或否认这些报道，但表示正在“非常认真地”对待这些报道。不过，发言人警告不要“对假设的危险过度紧张”。
据德国商报报道，欧洲航天局局长约瑟夫·阿施巴赫表示，在太空拥有核武器是“终极噩梦”。
俄罗斯是 1967 年《外层空间条约》的签署国，该条约禁止在轨道上使用大规模杀伤性武器。包括美国和中国在内的其他国家已经在太空部署或计划部署其他武器，探索条约之外的其他能力，例如瞄准对手的卫星——这对于军事通信、监视和导航至关重要。
2024年，美国声称俄罗斯正在开发一种配备核弹头的“天基”反卫星武器。俄罗斯否认了这一指控。
“我们的立场是明确和透明的。我们一直坚决反对在太空部署核武器，我们仍然反对，”弗拉基米尔·普京总统当时表示。
9月，美国空军部长特洛伊·梅克表示，美国拥有环绕地球的“在轨太空控制武器”，但没有提供具体细节。作为对这一消息的回应，克里姆林宫的佩斯科夫告诉俄罗斯媒体，太空“必须没有任何武器”。

title_en: Zelenskyy hails Ukraine's attack on a Russian warship docked at a naval base in Libya
title_zh: 泽连斯基赞扬乌克兰袭击一艘停靠在利比亚海军基地的俄罗斯军舰
summary: Ukraine carried out an attack on a Russian warship moored at a port in Libya, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said, claiming that sea drones sank the navy vessel in a surprise assault.
summary_zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，乌克兰对停泊在利比亚港口的一艘俄罗斯军舰进行了袭击，声称海上无人机击沉了该国军舰。
body_en: In this image made from video provided by Russian Defense Ministry Press Service on Sunday, July 16, 2023, a Russian navy corvette Merkury attends naval military exercises in the Baltic Sea. Russian Defense Ministry Press Service/AP hide caption

KYIV, Ukraine — Ukraine carried out an attack on a Russian warship moored at a port in Libya, President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said Monday, claiming that maritime drones sank the navy vessel in a surprise assault the previous day.

Ukrainian forces deployed seven drones in the operation that struck the Russian navy corvette in the Mediterranean, according to Zelenskyy. The ship, the Merkury, was one of Russia's newest vessels, commissioned a year after Moscow launched the 2022 full-scale invasion of its neighbor, he said in a post on X.
Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov declined to comment on the attack, saying that Russia's Defense Ministry would provide more information "if deemed to be appropriate."
The operation, conducted some 2,400 kilometers (1,500 miles) from the front line in Ukraine, was the latest daring long-range assault by Kyiv's forces.

Ukraine has at times embarrassed Moscow during the war with attacks such as Operation Spiderweb in June 2025, when drones launched from trucks hit over 40 aircraft parked at air bases across Russia. Along the roughly 1,250-kilometer (almost 800-mile) front line snaking through eastern and southern Ukraine, Kyiv's drones and ground robots are helping hold back Russia's bigger army.
At the same time, Russia's missiles and drones have devastated Ukraine's power grid ahead of winter and damaged civilian buildings.

A Russian strike on a five-story apartment block in a village near Kyiv killed 11 people, regional police said Monday. A 7-year-old child and a 79-year-old woman were pulled alive from the rubble after the Sunday morning attack, rescue services said.

Three people were killed Monday in a Russian strike on a hospital in the city of Zaporizhzhia in southern Ukraine, the regional military administration said. Two other people were killed when Russian forces struck a vehicle that bore markings indicating it was evacuating residents from the eastern city of Kramatorsk, authorities said.

Also on Monday, the European Commission proposed a new round of sanctions to keep economic pressure on Moscow, targeting dozens of Russian banks, cracking down on crypto platforms and slapping bans on sports teams and athletes competing under the country's flag.

The proposals, put forward by Commission President Ursula von der Leyen, must be endorsed by all 27 European Union member countries before they can enter into force. The process can take weeks, and the planned measures are likely to be modified.
The bloc has already hit more than 4,700 people and entities, including President Vladimir Putin, and several energy companies.
Zelenskyy lauds Ukrainian attacks from Siberia to Libya
Zelenskyy described Sunday's attack as "exemplary" and said "the targets we set were achieved."
"We continue our operations in designated waters. We are responding to Russia's aggression. We are developing Ukrainian weapons," he said.

Ukraine has hit Russian oil refineries as far away as western Siberia and Russian warships in the Mediterranean, Zelenskyy noted in a video address to a meeting of the NATO Parliamentary Assembly in Berlin.

An oil refinery in Russia's western Rostov region halted work Monday after what Gov. Yuri Slyusar said was a "massive" Ukrainian drone and missile attack that lasted more than six hours. Ukraine's General Staff said the refinery, located just a few dozen kilometers (miles) from the Ukrainian border, can process up to 55 million barrels of oil a year and was on fire after the attack.

Russian officials also reported Monday a Ukrainian attack on industrial sites in Russia's Perm region, more than 1,000 kilometers (620 miles) from Ukraine. One person was killed in the attack, and 56 Ukrainian drones were downed, Perm Gov. Dmitri Makhonin said.
"We keep finding ways to get back on our feet after every Russian attack," Zelenskyy said.

乌克兰基辅——总统泽连斯基周一表示，乌克兰对停泊在利比亚港口的一艘俄罗斯军舰进行了袭击，并声称海上无人机在前一天的突然袭击中击沉了这艘海军舰艇。
泽连斯基表示，乌克兰军队在地中海袭击俄罗斯海军护卫舰的行动中部署了七架无人机。他在 X 上的一篇帖子中表示，这艘名为“水星号”的船只是俄罗斯最新的船只之一，在莫斯科于 2022 年对其邻国发动全面入侵一年后投入使用。
克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫拒绝就此次袭击发表评论，称俄罗斯国防部“如果认为合适”将提供更多信息。
这次行动是在距乌克兰前线约 2,400 公里（1,500 英里）处进行的，是基辅部队最新一次大胆的远程攻击。
战争期间，乌克兰有时会发动袭击，例如 2025 年 6 月的蜘蛛网行动，当时从卡车发射的无人机击中了停在俄罗斯各地空军基地的 40 多架飞机。沿着蜿蜒穿过乌克兰东部和南部的约 1,250 公里（近 800 英里）前线，基辅的无人机和地面机器人正在帮助阻挡俄罗斯规模更大的军队。
与此同时，俄罗斯的导弹和无人机在冬季来临前摧毁了乌克兰的电网，并损坏了民用建筑。
地区警方周一表示，俄罗斯对基辅附近一个村庄的一座五层公寓楼发动袭击，造成 11 人死亡。救援部门称，周日上午的袭击事件后，一名 7 岁儿童和一名 79 岁妇女被从废墟中救出。
地区军事管理局称，俄罗斯周一对乌克兰南部扎波罗热市一家医院发动袭击，造成三人死亡。当局称，俄罗斯军队撞上了一辆带有标记的车辆，表明该车正在从东部城市克拉马托尔斯克疏散居民，造成另外两人死亡。
同样在周一，欧盟委员会提出了新一轮制裁措施，以保持对莫斯科的经济压力，制裁对象是数十家俄罗斯银行，打击加密货币平台，并禁止代表俄罗斯参加比赛的运动队和运动员。
这些提案由欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩提出，必须得到所有 27 个欧盟成员国的认可才能生效。该过程可能需要数周时间，并且计划的措施可能会被修改。

泽伦斯基赞扬乌克兰从西伯利亚到利比亚的袭击
泽伦斯基将周日的袭击描述为“典范”，并表示“我们设定的目标已经实现”。
“我们继续在指定水域开展行动。我们正在回应俄罗斯的侵略。我们正在开发乌克兰武器，”他说。
泽伦斯基在柏林举行的北约议会会议上的视频讲话中指出，乌克兰袭击了远至西西伯利亚西部的俄罗斯炼油厂和地中海的俄罗斯军舰。
俄罗斯西部罗斯托夫地区的一家炼油厂周一停止了生产，此前州长尤里·斯柳萨尔表示，乌克兰发动了一场持续了六个多小时的“大规模”无人机和导弹袭击。乌克兰总参谋部表示，该炼油厂距离乌克兰边境仅几十公里，每年可加工多达 5500 万桶石油，在袭击后已起火。
俄罗斯官员周一还报告称，乌克兰对俄罗斯彼尔姆地区的工业场地发动袭击，该地区距乌克兰 1,000 多公里（620 英里）。彼尔姆州州长德米特里·马霍宁 (Dmitri Makhonin) 表示，袭击造成 1 人死亡，56 架乌克兰无人机被击落。
泽伦斯基说：“每次俄罗斯袭击后，我们都在寻找重新站起来的方法。”

title_en: Russian warship sinks in Benghazi after suspected Ukrainian drone attack
title_zh: 疑似乌克兰无人机袭击后俄罗斯军舰在班加西沉没
summary: No one has claimed responsibility for the strike on the vessel, which had docked on its way back to Russia A Russian warship docked in the Libyan port city of Benghazi was struck in the early hours of Sunday in a suspected Ukrainian sea drone attack, causing a
summary_zh: 没有人声称对这艘在返回俄罗斯途中停靠的船只的袭击负责 一艘停靠在利比亚港口的俄罗斯军舰
body_en: No one has claimed responsibility for the strike on the vessel, which had docked on its way back to Russia

A Russian warship docked in the Libyan port city of Benghazi was struck in the early hours of Sunday in a suspected Ukrainian sea drone attack, causing a dramatic night-time explosion and the sinking of the vessel.
The strike severely damaged the Merkury, a Russian navy corvette that had stopped to refuel and take on supplies, according to Libyan officials from the country’s eastern government.

Initial reports said several Ukrainian sea drones were launched at the ship. At least four drones were intercepted and destroyed, while two hit the warship, triggering the explosion, the officials told the Associated Press.

Satellite imagery showed the Merkury had sunk after the attack, which took place in the Mediterranean, more than 1,000 miles from south Ukraine , marking a notable geographic expansion of the now near five-year war.

Though Ukraine began the war with no navy, it has developed a sea drone capability that threatened Russian warships in the Black Sea. The Russian fleet has been forced to retreat to the eastern port of Novorossiysk because Sevastopol in occupied Crimea had become unsafe.

Hours later, a Russia-linked cargo ship said to be carrying military supplies, the Ascalon, was hit by a sea drone off the coast of Benghazi. Video showed the drone heading directly towards one end of the vessel, again causing a huge explosion.

Libyan naval forces ‌rescued the vessel’s crew, the ‌sources added. The health ministry said some crew members were in stable condition with minor injuries. The number of injured and their nationalities are not known.
Benghazi is controlled by the self-styled Libyan National Army, led by Gen Khalifa Haftar, which controls eastern and southern Libya and has been aligned with Russia.

There was no immediate reaction from Russian authorities, and no immediate claim of responsibility for the strike, but it comes as Ukrainian forces have stepped up their long-range attacks against Russia far beyond the frontlines.
The UN mission in Libya (Unsmil) expressed “serious concern” over the two drone attacks off Benghazi and called for “an immediate, independent and transparent investigation”, in a post on X.

The ‌eastern-based Libyan authority said port and naval base facilities, including warehouses, were safe and that ​normal operations would resume once the fire was brought under control and the site secured.
It condemned the suspected attack as a violation of Libya’s sovereignty and ⁠a threat to maritime safety, saying it would take ​legal and ​diplomatic measures against ​anyone found responsible.
“The Libyan government will not ​allow Libyan ‌ports, territory or territorial ​waters ​to be turned into an arena for settling scores or exporting international conflicts,” it said.

The specialist website Naval News earlier identified the ship attacked as the Merkury, a Russian corvette – the smallest class of warship, smaller than a frigate – and said it had almost certainly been destroyed.

HI Sutton, a naval analyst, said the attack was probably conducted by sea drones, after a photograph of one emerged apparently taken off the Libyan coast. The drone, he said, “is also likely the type used in the subsequent attack”. Similar-looking drones were involved in the subsequent attack on the Ascalon cargo ship.

If it is confirmed that Ukraine has been able to blow up or seriously damage a Russian warship in Benghazi, it would represent one of its most successful naval strikes during the almost five-year war.
But it also represents a risky extension of the fighting far beyond eastern Europe, in an incident that could affect civilians on another continent and the working of the port.

A small unit of Ukrainian special forces operatives has been based at Misrata, western Libya, and is believed to have coordinated drone attacks on Russian tankers and transport ships in the past year.
body_zh: 没有人声称对这艘在返回俄罗斯途中停靠的船只的袭击负责
周日凌晨，一艘停靠在利比亚港口城市班加西的俄罗斯军舰在疑似乌克兰海上无人机袭击中被击中，导致夜间剧烈爆炸并导致船只沉没。
利比亚东部政府官员表示，这次袭击严重损坏了俄罗斯海军护卫舰“水星”号，该护卫舰当时已停下来加油和补给。
初步报道称，几架乌克兰海上无人机向这艘船发射。官员们告诉美联社，至少四架无人机被拦截并摧毁，其中两架击中了军舰，引发了爆炸。
卫星图像显示，这次袭击发生在距离乌克兰南部1000多英里的地中海，水星号已经沉没，这标志着近五年战争的地理范围显着扩大。
尽管乌克兰在没有海军的情况下开始战争，但它已经发展了海上无人机能力，威胁黑海的俄罗斯军舰。由于被占领的克里米亚塞瓦斯托波尔变得不安全，俄罗斯舰队被迫撤退到新罗西斯克东部港口。
几小时后，一艘据称载有军事物资的与俄罗斯有关的货船阿斯卡隆号在班加西海岸被一架海上无人机击中。视频显示，无人机直接飞向船只的一端，再次引发巨大爆炸。
消息人士补充说，利比亚海军营救了该船的船员。卫生部表示，一些船员受轻伤，情况稳定。受伤人数及其国籍尚不清楚。
班加西由哈利法·哈夫塔尔将军领导的自封的利比亚国民军控制，该军控制着利比亚东部和南部，并与俄罗斯结盟。
俄罗斯当局没有立即做出反应，也没有立即声称对这次袭击负责，但与此同时，乌克兰军队已经加强了对远离前线的俄罗斯的远程攻击。
联合国驻利比亚特派团 (Unsmil) 在 X 上发帖，对班加西附近的两起无人机袭击表示“严重关切”，并呼吁“立即进行独立和透明的调查”。
总部位于东部的利比亚当局表示，包括仓库在内的港口和海军基地设施是安全的，一旦火势得到控制并确保现场安全，就会恢复正常运营。
它谴责这起疑似袭击事件侵犯了利比亚的主权，并对海上安全构成威胁，并表示将对任何责任人采取法律和外交措施。
声明称：“利比亚政府不会允许利比亚港口、领土或领海成为算账或输出国际冲突的竞技场。”
专业网站《海军新闻》早些时候确认，这艘遭到袭击的船只是俄罗斯护卫舰“水星号”——最小级别的军舰，比护卫舰还要小——并表示它几乎肯定已被摧毁。
海军分析家萨顿 (HI Sutton) 表示，这次袭击可能是由海上无人机实施的，因为一张照片显然是在利比亚海岸拍摄的。他说，这架无人机“也可能是随后袭击中使用的类型”。类似的无人机参与了随后对阿斯卡隆货船的袭击。
如果确认乌克兰能够在班加西炸毁或严重损坏一艘俄罗斯军舰，这将是近五年战争中乌克兰最成功的海上打击之一。
但这也代表着战斗有可能延伸到东欧以外的地区，这一事件可能会影响另一个大陆的平民和港口的运作。
乌克兰特种部队的一小支部队驻扎在利比亚西部的米苏拉塔，据信在过去一年里协调无人机袭击了俄罗斯油轮和运输船。

title_en: Malaysia to send thousands of migrants back to Myanmar as PM acknowledges junta’s ‘atrocities’
title_zh: 马来西亚总理承认军政府的“暴行”，将遣返数千名移民
summary: Prime minister Anwar Ibrahim’s announcement comes days after the ICJ found Myanmar had committed genocide against the Rohingya minority Malaysia says it will send thousands of migrants and refugees back to Myanmar, despite acknowledging that many asylum seeker
summary_zh: 马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣 (Anwar Ibrahim) 宣布这一消息是在国际法院发现缅甸对罗辛亚少数民族实施种族灭绝几天后
body_en: Prime minister Anwar Ibrahim’s announcement comes days after the ICJ found Myanmar had committed genocide against the Rohingya minority

Malaysia says it will send thousands of migrants and refugees back to Myanmar, despite acknowledging that many asylum seekers in the country had been victims of “atrocities” carried ​out by the junta in Naypyidaw.
The announcement comes just days after the UN’s highest court ruled Myanmar had committed genocide against its Rohingya minority.

Malaysia’s prime minister, Anwar Ibrahim, said on Tuesday that the deportations were in line with advice from the international court of justice (ICJ), which was “to guarantee a safe and dignified return” for those fleeing persecution, and his country had not abandoned its principles of upholding the rights of the people of Myanmar .
Malaysia begins Myanmar repatriations despite warnings from UN and rights groups
The UN has previously warned that migrants sent back to Myanmar could face a dangerous homecoming.

It is unclear how many Rohingya, a Muslim minority group, are among those facing deportation. However, the Rohingya make up two-thirds of the 190,000 Myanmar refugees and asylum seekers in Malaysia, according to the UN. Many of the Rohingya escaped to Malaysia during a brutal military crackdown in 2017.

Anwar acknowledged that many asylum seekers in Malaysia were “victims of atrocities carried ​out by the Myanmar regime”, but said Malaysia could ‌no longer afford to host refugees. Hoping for them to be resettled in third countries had not worked, he said.

Many in Malaysia have grown increasingly frustrated by ‌the presence of refugees in the country, saying that hosting them has become a financial burden and a security risk, with a rise in anti-migrant sentiment in the country.

On Tuesday Anwar told Malaysia’s parliament that three naval ships would return 1,500 people in December, with an additional 5,303 people flown back by aircraft at the expense of the Myanmar government.
Tuesday’s announcement follows last week’s ICJ ruling in The Hague that Myanmar had committed genocide against the Rohingya.

The ICJ had never previously found a state responsible for genocide, and the judgment ended a seven-year legal battle that was seen as a critical global test for dealing with the most serious of all state crimes.

The 2016-17 campaign by Myanmar’s military forced more than 700,000 mostly Muslim Rohingya to flee across the border into Bangladesh, arriving with reports of mass killings of adults and children, gang rapes and burnt-down villages.
In its judgment, the ICJ said Myanmar authorities must “allow and facilitate the safe, voluntary and dignified return” of refugees displaced either within Myanmar or abroad.
When you see smoke, run: Rohingya who escaped Myanmar’s genocide tell their stories
In September, Malaysia began sending back a group of about 1,500 Myanmar nationals as it launched its contested repatriation plan.
Malaysia’s government said in a statement at the time that the repatriation was necessary to resolve the “legacy issue” of foreign asylum seekers in Malaysia – of which it said 95% were from Myanmar.

“This long-standing issue has imposed a significant financial burden on the nation, triggered serious social crises, and created tangible security threats for the Malaysian people,” the statement said.
The UN had urged Malaysia to stop that repatriation, saying nobody should be deported to Myanmar, given the severity of the situation on the ground.
body_zh: 总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣 (Anwar Ibrahim) 宣布这一消息是在国际法院发现缅甸对罗辛亚少数民族实施种族灭绝几天后
马来西亚表示将把数千名移民和难民送回缅甸，尽管承认该国许多寻求庇护者是内比都军政府实施“暴行”的受害者。
就在这一消息发布几天前，联合国最高法院裁定缅甸对其罗辛亚少数民族实施种族灭绝。
马来西亚总理安瓦尔·易卜拉欣周二表示，驱逐行动符合国际法院（ICJ）的建议，即“保证那些逃离迫害的人安全和有尊严地返回”，马来西亚没有放弃维护缅甸人民权利的原则。
马来西亚不顾联合国和人权组织的警告，开始遣返缅甸人
联合国此前曾警告称，被送回缅甸的移民可能面临危险的返乡。
目前尚不清楚有多少罗兴亚人（穆斯林少数民族）面临被驱逐出境。然而，根据联合国的数据，罗兴亚人占马来西亚 19 万缅甸难民和寻求庇护者的三分之二。 2017 年残酷的军事镇压期间，许多罗辛亚人逃往马来西亚。
安瓦尔承认，马来西亚的许多寻求庇护者是“缅甸政权暴行的受害者”，但表示马来西亚再也无力收容难民。他说，希望他们在第三国重新定居的希望没有奏效。
马来西亚的许多人对该国境内难民的存在越来越感到沮丧，他们表示，随着该国反移民情绪的上升，收容他们已成为经济负担和安全风险。
周二，安瓦尔告诉马来西亚议会，三艘海军舰艇将于 12 月遣返 1,500 人，另有 5,303 人乘飞机回国，费用由缅甸政府承担。
周二宣布这一消息之前，国际法院上周在海牙做出裁决，裁定缅甸对罗兴亚人实施了种族灭绝。
国际法院此前从未认定某个国家对种族灭绝负有责任，该判决结束了长达七年的法律斗争，这场法律斗争被视为处理所有国家罪行中最严重的一项关键的全球考验。
缅甸军方在 2016-17 年发起的行动迫使超过 70 万罗兴亚人（其中大部分是穆斯林）越过边境逃往孟加拉国，并带来了大规模屠杀成人和儿童、轮奸和烧毁村庄的报道。
国际法院在判决中表示，缅甸当局必须“允许并便利缅甸境内或国外流离失所的难民安全、自愿和有尊严地返回”。
当你看到烟雾时，逃跑：逃离缅甸种族灭绝的罗兴亚人讲述他们的故事
9 月，马来西亚启动了备受争议的遣返计划，开始遣返约 1,500 名缅甸国民。
马来西亚政府当时在一份声明中表示，遣返对于解决马来西亚外国寻求庇护者的“遗留问题”是必要的——据称其中 95% 来自缅甸。
声明说：“这个长期存在的问题给国家带来了沉重的财政负担，引发了严重的社会危机，并对马来西亚人民造成了切实的安全威胁。”
联合国敦促马来西亚停止遣返，称鉴于当地局势的严重性，不应将任何人驱逐到缅甸。

title_en: South Korea tells island residents to take shelter after Russian military aircraft approach
title_zh: 俄罗斯军机接近后韩国要求岛上居民避难
summary: The order was issued after aircraft entered the country’s air defence identification zone over the island of Ulleungdo Residents of a remote South Korean island were ordered to take shelter on Tuesday morning after several Russian military aircraft came close
summary_zh: 该命令是在飞机进入郁陵岛上空的韩国防空识别区后发布的。
body_en: The order was issued after aircraft entered the country’s air defence identification zone over the island of Ulleungdo

Residents of a remote South Korean island were ordered to take shelter on Tuesday morning after several Russian military aircraft came close to entering its airspace, prompting a pre-emptive alert from the military that anticipated a violation.
The defence ministry said it would summon the Russian defence attaché on Tuesday afternoon to lodge a strong protest.

The joint chiefs of staff (JCS) said the aircraft had entered the country’s air defence identification zone over the Sea of Japan – known in South Korea as the East Sea – and approached the island of Ulleungdo. It did not specify how many Russian aircraft were involved, but South Korean air force jets were scrambled before the aircraft left.

A JCS spokesperson, Jang Do-young, said the aircraft had approached “to the point just before violating Ulleungdo’s airspace” and that, because military aircraft move very fast, a violation was anticipated.
The Kuril Islands: how a visit from Putin reignited a 150-year-old dispute between Japan and Russia
The alert was issued pre-emptively to protect residents, he said.

The interior ministry issued the emergency alert at 7.52am to residents of Ulleungdo, a volcanic island of about 8,700 people 120km off the east coast, telling them to take shelter. The English portion of the message read: “EVACUATION, AIR RAID”.

Television broadcasts were interrupted by on-screen warnings telling residents to “prepare to evacuate to a nearby underground shelter facility and listen to broadcasting”. The alert was lifted at 7.55am.

On the island, sirens sounded and residents reportedly heard the noise of fighter jets. Jeong Hae-seung, 41, who was working on a building site, told the Hankyoreh newspaper he ran out of his workplace the moment the text arrived.
“I went outside wondering what on earth was going on, and the civil defence broadcast was playing, but I couldn’t make out what it was saying,” he said.
Baek Un-bae, who lives on the island, told broadcaster YTN that an elderly resident had telephoned him asking whether war had broken out.
“Older people have no access to the media, so all they hear is the warning broadcast and they are too alarmed to know what to do,” he said.
Others said they did not hear the sirens at all, with windows shut against the cold and strong winds blowing.
A second message, sent by North Gyeongsang province, which administers Ulleungdo, said a flying object “presumed to be a North Korean aircraft” had left the danger zone.
The province said it had mistakenly taken the wording from its routine drill messages, changed only the time and sent it in error.
Jang described the alert as unusual but said he could not confirm whether it was the first of its kind.
Tuesday’s incident was the fourth known entry by Russian military aircraft into the zone this year and the second in a week.

An air defence identification zone is not sovereign airspace, but countries establish such zones beyond their own airspace to identify incoming military flights early. While submitting a flight plan in advance is international practice, entering an identification zone without prior notification does not in itself violate international law.
body_zh: 该命令是在飞机进入郁陵岛上空的韩国防空识别区后发布的
周二早上，几架俄罗斯军用飞机接近进入韩国一个偏远岛屿的领空，导致韩国军方发出先发制人的警报，预计会有违规行为，当地居民被勒令避难。
国防部表示将于周二下午召见俄罗斯武官提出强烈抗议。
参谋长联席会议（JCS）表示，这架飞机已进入日本海（韩国称为东海）上空的韩国防空识别区，并接近郁陵岛。报道没有具体说明有多少架俄罗斯飞机参与其中，但韩国空军战机在飞机离开前紧急紧急升空。
联合参谋长联席会议发言人张道英 (Jang Do-young) 表示，这架飞机已接近“即将侵犯郁陵岛领空”，而且由于军用飞机移动速度非常快，预计会发生违规行为。
千岛群岛：普京的访问如何重新点燃日俄之间长达 150 年的争​​端
他说，这一警报是为了保护居民而先发制人的。
内政部于上午 7 点 52 分向距离东海岸 120 公里的郁陵岛火山岛居民发出紧急警报，要求他们避难。郁陵岛是一座火山岛，约有 8,700 人。消息的英文部分写着：“疏散，空袭”。
电视广播被屏幕上的警告打断，警告居民“准备疏散到附近的地下避难设施并收听广播”。警报于上午 7.55 解除。
岛上警报响起，据报道居民听到战斗机的噪音。 41 岁的郑海承 (Jeong Hae-seung) 正在建筑工地工作，他告诉《韩民族报》，短信一到，他就跑出了工作场所。
“我走到外面想知道到底发生了什么事，民防广播正在播放，但我听不清它在说什么，”他说。
住在岛上的白云培 (Baek Un-bae) 告诉 YTN 广播公司，一位老年居民打电话给他，询问是否爆发了战争。
“老年人无法接触媒体，所以他们听到的只是警告广播，他们太惊慌了，不知道该怎么办，”他说。
其他人则表示，他们根本没有听到警报声，因为窗户紧闭，以抵御寒冷和强风的吹袭。
管理郁陵岛的庆尚北道省发出的第二条信息称，“疑似朝鲜飞机”的飞行物体已离开危险区域。
该省表示，他们错误地从例行演习信息中获取了措辞，仅更改了时间并错误地发送了该信息。
张称这次警报不同寻常，但表示他无法确认这是否是第一次此类警报。
周二的事件是已知的俄罗斯军用飞机今年第四次进入该区域，也是一周内的第二次。
防空识别区不是主权空域，但各国在自己的空域之外设立防空识别区，以便及早识别来袭的军事航班。虽然提前提交飞行计划是国际惯例，但未经事先通知而进入识别区本身并不违反国际法。

title_en: Russian incursions into NATO territory are increasing
title_zh: 俄罗斯对北约领土的入侵正在增加
summary: NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte is seeking to reassure the alliance's eastern European members after three Russian cruise missiles landed in Poland on Friday.
summary_zh: 在三枚俄罗斯巡航导弹落在波兰后，北约秘书长马克·吕特正在寻求安抚该联盟的东欧成员国
body_en: Russian incursions into NATO territory are increasing NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte is seeking to reassure the alliance's eastern European members after three Russian cruise missiles landed in Poland on Friday.
NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte is seeking to reassure the alliance's eastern European members after three Russian cruise missiles landed in Poland on Friday.

DETROW: The cruise missiles hit Poland during one of Russia's biggest aerial attacks on Ukraine since the start of the full-scale invasion. Ukraine then hit back over the weekend. So first, bring us up to speed on that.

NICHOLSON: Well, as you say, the risks of the war in Ukraine spilling over were loud and clear over the weekend. It started on Friday morning with what Polish authorities have now identified as three Russian cruise missiles striking a rural part of southeastern Poland, about 30 miles from the Ukrainian border. Now, as you say, there were no casualties, but the incursions happened while European forces were staging a military exercise in the region. And Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk calls the incident an "intentional provocation" - that's a quote.

Then on Saturday, a sanctioned Russian cargo ship in the Baltic Sea was hit by what is suspected to have been a Ukrainian maritime drone. And on Sunday, Ukraine took credit for sinking a Russian warship docked in the Libyan port of Benghazi, thousands of miles from the front line. Libyan authorities have condemned the attack in their port, reflecting broader concerns that the conflict could spread far beyond Europe.
DETROW: Right. And that is a broad battlefield that you're talking about right there. NATO's chief was in Berlin today. Does he view this as the beginning of an escalation beyond Ukraine's borders?

NICHOLSON: Well, Rutte was rather cautious in his assessment of the weekend. He was in Berlin for an annual meeting, talking to parliamentarians from NATO countries. And while he acknowledged the danger of cruise missile incursions, he was eager that Polish authorities finish their investigations to establish whether they were intentional or not. Speaking to journalists, he said the alliance has, quote, "many response options" (ph) but that he can't always be open about them. But he also appealed for public support for Ukraine.
MARK RUTTE: As societies, we have to be resilient and, most importantly, keep that support for Ukraine going. So for every incident in Europe, more support for Ukraine, not less support for Ukraine.
NICHOLSON: And Zelenskyy, who dialed into the meeting in Berlin today, urged for fresh negotiations with Russia, this time involving the Europeans.
DETROW: Let's talk more about the Europeans. What do you think the odds are that they'll end up playing a role in bringing about the end of this war?

NICHOLSON: Well, since last week's coalition of the willing meeting here in Berlin, it's looking a little more likely. German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and European leaders warned the U.S. and Russia against going over their heads. And today, Merz stressed that Europe is ready to sit at the table, something U.S. special envoy for peace missions Jared Kushner supports. But Merz also made it clear that no NATO member, quote, "has any interest in an escalation in the Baltic Sea region," which some see as an appeal to Ukraine to do its part to prevent the conflict from spreading.

He vowed that European leaders would discuss boosting defense on NATO's eastern flank at an EU summit later this week. And he was also quite candid in stating that NATO made a mistake back in 2008 when it decided not to make Ukraine a member, saying that if Ukraine had been a NATO member, this war would probably have been preventable.
DETROW: That is Esme Nicholson in Berlin. Thank you so much.

body_zh: 俄罗斯对北约领土的入侵正在增加，周五三枚俄罗斯巡航导弹落在波兰后，北约秘书长马克·吕特正在寻求安抚北约东欧成员国。
周五三枚俄罗斯巡航导弹落在波兰后，北约秘书长马克·吕特正在寻求安抚该联盟的东欧成员国。
德特罗：巡航导弹击中了波兰，这是俄罗斯自全面入侵乌克兰以来对乌克兰最大规模的空袭之一。乌克兰随后在周末进行了反击。首先，请让我们了解最新情况。
尼科尔森：嗯，正如你所说，乌克兰战争蔓延的风险在周末是响亮而明显的。事件始于周五早上，波兰当局现已确认三枚俄罗斯巡航导弹袭击了波兰东南部的农村地区，距离乌克兰边境约 30 英里。现在，正如你所说，没有人员伤亡，但入侵发生时欧洲军队正在该地区举行军事演习。波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克称这一事件是“故意挑衅”——这是一句话。
周六，波罗的海一艘受制裁的俄罗斯货船被疑似乌克兰海上无人机击中。周日，乌克兰因击沉一艘停靠在距离前线数千英里的利比亚班加西港的俄罗斯军舰而受到赞扬。利比亚当局谴责了发生在其港口的袭击事件，反映出人们更广泛地担心冲突可能蔓延到欧洲以外的地区。
德特罗： 是的。这就是你所说的广阔战场。北约领导人今天在柏林。他是否认为这是乌克兰境外局势升级的开始？
尼科尔森：嗯，吕特对周末的评估相当谨慎。他在柏林参加年度会​​议，与北约国家的议员交谈。虽然他承认巡航导弹入侵的危险，但他渴望波兰当局完成调查，以确定它们是否是故意的。他在接受记者采访时表示，联盟有“许多应对方案”，但他不能总是对这些方案持开放态度。但他也呼吁公众支持乌克兰。
马克·鲁特：作为社会，我们必须保持韧性，最重要的是，保持对乌克兰的支持。因此，对于欧洲发生的每一起事件，都应该更多地支持乌克兰，而不是更少地支持乌克兰。
尼科尔森：泽伦斯基今天拨通了柏林会议的电话，敦促与俄罗斯进行新的谈判，这次涉及欧洲人。
德特罗：让我们更多地谈谈欧洲人。您认为他们最终为结束这场战争发挥作用的可能性有多大？
尼科尔森：嗯，自从上周在柏林举行自愿联盟会议以来，这种可能性看起来更大一些。德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨和欧洲领导人警告美国和俄罗斯不要越权。今天，默茨强调欧洲已准备好坐到谈判桌前，美国和平使命特使贾里德·库什纳对此表示支持。但梅尔茨也明确表示，北约成员国“对波罗的海地区的局势升级没有任何兴趣”，一些人认为这是在呼吁乌克兰尽自己的一份力量，防止冲突蔓延。
他发誓欧洲领导人将在本周晚些时候的欧盟峰会上讨论加强北约东翼的防御。他还相当坦诚地指出，北约在2008年决定不让乌克兰加入时就犯了一个错误，并表示如果乌克兰是北约成员国，这场战争或许是可以避免的。
德特罗：这是柏林的埃斯梅·尼科尔森。太感谢了。

title_en: Butt of the joke: Trump impersonator mocks president at Canada press dinner
title_zh: 笑话的笑柄：特朗普模仿者在加拿大新闻晚宴上嘲笑总统
summary: Carney watches on as comedian lampoons US leader and his interest in men’s backsides at correspondents’ event Ottawa Canada’s prime minister, Mark Carney, was joined on stage in Ottawa by a Donald Trump impersonator who mocked the US president to raucous laugh
summary_zh: 卡尼在渥太华记者活动中观看喜剧演员讽刺美国领导人及其对男性臀部的兴趣加拿大总理马克·卡
body_en: Carney watches on as comedian lampoons US leader and his interest in men’s backsides at correspondents’ event Ottawa

Canada’s prime minister, Mark Carney, was joined on stage in Ottawa by a Donald Trump impersonator who mocked the US president to raucous laughter from a crowd of politicians and journalists at a parliamentary press gallery dinner on Saturday.

With coiffed hair and an ill-fitting suit, comedian Mark Critch – who portrays the president on the sketch show This Hour Has 22 Minutes – danced on to the stage and lampooned the trade war Trump started as well as the president’s threats to annex Canada .
“We’re going to have a great deal,” Critch said, channeling Trump’s distinct mannerisms. “There’s only one thing standing in the way: me, because I’m crazy.”
The fake Trump continued that he was “so popular we just had a big, blue wave”, a reference to the Democratic rout of Republicans in this month’s US midterm elections.

He also mocked Trump’s frequent mentions of other men’s physiques, saying of the comedian Mark McKinney, who was portraying Carney, that he had “a great ass – doesn’t he? What a beautiful ass, he’s got such an incredible ass.”
Trump forced to play good sport at correspondents’ dinner – but it couldn’t last

He earned the most laughter of his short appearance for saying of Carney: “I don’t call him the governor to his face, because I’m a coward”. The real Trump has frequently attempted to insult Canada’s leaders by calling them governor, not prime minister, suggesting Canada is a US state.
The annual dinner, attended by media, political leaders and lobbyists, is often defined by carefully written jokes by the staff of party leaders.
Throughout his own 16-minute set, Carney poked fun at his political rivals, the media and the US president.
At one point, he remarked: “Damn, this is a tough room, and I’ve been in the Oval Office. Alone. With its new interior decorator.”
Clips of the dinner, including the crowd laughing at the president, have circulated widely on US media.
The newly appointed governor general, Louise Arbour, also gave a speech, including a nod to the prime minister’s decision to travel extensively around the globe.

“Our prime minister is already getting a lot of attention. Actually, I heard a guy the other day compare him to God. Now seriously, do you know the difference between God and Mark Carney ? God is everywhere, and Mark Carney is everywhere except in Ottawa where he’s supposed to be,” she said.
The Conservative leader, Pierre Poilievre, also used the evening to poke fun at his own reputation.

“Some say that Mark has a controlling leadership style. There’s been reports that he yells and micromanages his staff. He acts like a miserable prick to journalists,” he said. “And when I hear things like that, I say once again, he’s stealing all my ideas.”

He attracted a stunned silence, however, for alluding to Justin Trudeau’s relationship with Katy Perry, saying, “Trudeau is running around the world doing to a faded pop princess what he did to Canada” while prime minister, a remark that was widely criticised as demeaning to the pop star.

The New Democratic party leader, Avi Lewis, who has not yet won a seat in parliament, took a shot at Carney’s early exit from the event, as well his own party’s dismal standings. “I do not have a seat in the House of Commons, but when I am given one at dinner, I stay there all night long,” he said.
body_zh: 卡尼在渥太华记者活动中观看喜剧演员讽刺美国领导人及其对男性臀部的兴趣
周六，加拿大总理马克·卡尼在渥太华举行的议会记者席晚宴上，一名模仿唐纳德·特朗普的人与加拿大总理马克·卡尼一起登上舞台，他嘲笑美国总统，引起一群政界人士和记者的哄堂大笑。
喜剧演员马克·克里奇 (Mark Critch) 梳着整齐的头发，穿着不合身的西装，在小品节目《这一小时有 22 分钟》中扮演总统，他在舞台上跳舞，讽刺特朗普发起的贸易战以及总统吞并加拿大的威胁。
“我们将会达成很多协议，”克里奇说道，传达了特朗普独特的言行举止。 “只有一件事阻碍了我：我，因为我疯了。”
假特朗普继续说，他“太受欢迎了，我们刚刚掀起了一股巨大的蓝色浪潮”，指的是本月美国中期选举中民主党对共和党的溃败。
他还嘲笑特朗普经常提到其他男人的体格，在谈到扮演卡尼的喜剧演员马克·麦金尼时，他说他有“一个很棒的屁股——不是吗？多么漂亮的屁股啊，他有一个令人难以置信的屁股。”
特朗普被迫在记者晚宴上表现出色，但这种情况无法持续
他在短暂的露面中赢得最多笑声的是，他对卡尼说：“我不会当面称他为州长，因为我是个胆小鬼”。真正的特朗普经常试图侮辱加拿大领导人，称他们为州长，而不是总理，暗示加拿大是美国的一个州。
每年一度的晚宴由媒体、政治领导人和游说者参加，通常由政党领导人的工作人员精心编写的笑话来定义。
在他自己的 16 分钟节目中，卡尼取笑了他的政治对手、媒体和美国总统。
有一次，他说道：“该死，这真是一个艰难的房间，而我一直在椭圆形办公室里。独自一人。还有新的室内设计师。”
晚宴的片段，包括人群嘲笑总统的片段，在美国媒体上广泛流传。
新任命的总督路易丝·阿尔布尔也发表了讲话，其中包括对总理环球旅行的决定表示认可。
“我们的总理已经引起了很多关注。事实上，我前几天听到一个人把他比作上帝。现在说真的，你知道上帝和马克·卡尼之间的区别吗？上帝无处不在，而马克·卡尼也无处不在，除了他应该在的渥太华，”她说。
保守党领袖皮埃尔·波利耶夫也利用当晚的机会嘲笑自己的声誉。
“有人说马克具有控制型领导风格。有报道称，他对员工大喊大叫，对员工进行微观管理。对记者来说，他的表现就像一个可悲的混蛋，”他说。 “当我听到这样的事情时，我再说一遍，他窃取了我所有的想法。”
然而，他在暗示贾斯汀·特鲁多与凯蒂·佩里的关系时引起了震惊的沉默，他说，“特鲁多在担任总理期间，正在世界各地对一位褪色的流行公主做他对加拿大所做的事情”，这一言论被广泛批评为贬低这位流行歌星。
尚未在议会赢得席位的新民主党领袖阿维·刘易斯对卡尼提前退出该活动以及该党惨淡的支持率进行了批评。 “我在下议院没有席位，但当我在晚餐时得到一个席位时，我会整夜待在那里，”他说。

title_en: UK sanctions top Myanmar military leaders after Rohingya genocide ruling
title_zh: 罗兴亚种族灭绝裁决后英国制裁缅甸最高军事领导人
summary: The UK is joined by several other nations in recognising an ICJ ruling that Myanmar carried out genocide.
summary_zh: 英国与其他几个国家一起承认国际法院关于缅甸实施种族灭绝的裁决。
body_en: The UK has sanctioned five senior Myanmar military leaders after the International Court of Justice (ICJ) ruled that the country had carried out genocide against the Rohingya minority – marking the first time a state has been found guilty of the crime .
A military crackdown in 2017 killed thousands of Rohingya and forced more than 700,000 to flee Buddhist-majority Myanmar, formerly known as Burma.
The UK is joined by several other countries , external in acknowledging the ICJ ruling, including Australia, Belgium, Portugal, Spain and Canada.
Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband said: "Our response to a crime as profoundly shocking as genocide must reflect our values and must be matched by clear action."
Bowen: Myanmar genocide verdict is historic and could have far-reaching implications
The senior military leaders facing sanctions are Myo Htut Hlaing, Myo Min Tun, Myat Thet Oo, Kyaw Soe and Kyaw Swar Oo.

Miliband added that Myanmar's President Min Aung Hlaing , who was sanctioned by the UK in 2021, is "directly responsible for many of the atrocities that have happened" as he was head of the military at the time of the genocide in 2017.
He said: "Myanmar must stop ongoing violations, investigate, prosecute and punish perpetrators, and prevent such an atrocity from ever happening again."

Miliband also called for an "immediate pause in hostilities to enable humanitarian aid to get through, a stop to air strikes on civilians, and the release of political prisoners, as well as dialogue towards an inclusive political settlement".
The foreign secretary confirmed that new legislation would be passed to stop the supply of aviation fuel to the country, which was known as Burma until 1989.
Last week, he expelled Myanmar's defence attaché after the ICJ ruled the country had committed genocide during the brutal military campaign in 2017.
He told MPs on Monday the UK would raise the issue at the UN Security Council this week, and there would be a dedicated meeting in a fortnight.
The court found on Thursday that "genocidal intent is the only reasonable inference that can be drawn from the evidence" it had seen.

The verdict was reached by a majority of nine votes to six among a panel of judges from around the world. The ICJ also found in favour by majority that Myanmar had violated several other parts of the 1948 Genocide Convention , external .

In its ruling last week, the court determined that about 10,000 Rohingya were murdered during the clearance operation in the western Rakhine state that borders Bangladesh and the Bay of Bengal. Myanmar denied the claims against it.
Reports said that entire villages were burnt down, and that women and girls were raped.
Miliband said more than 1.2 million refugees fled and were being supported by Bangladesh.
Myanmar's leader during the genocide, Aung San Suu Kyi , was deposed by the military in 2021.
MPs heard that air strikes and violence from the Arakan army were still happening.
body_zh: 在国际法院（ICJ）裁定该国对罗辛亚少数民族实施种族灭绝之后，英国制裁了五名缅甸高级军事领导人，这标志着一个国家首次被判有罪。
2017 年的一次军事镇压导致数千罗兴亚人死亡，并迫使超过 70 万人逃离佛教徒占多数的缅甸（以前称为缅甸）。缅甸否认了针对其的指控，称其军队对武装团体的袭击做出了回应。
英国与其他几个外部国家一起承认国际法院的裁决，包括澳大利亚、比利时、葡萄牙、西班牙和加拿大。
英国外交大臣埃德·米利班德表示：“我们对种族灭绝这样令人震惊的罪行的反应必须反映我们的价值观，并且必须采取明确的行动。”
鲍文：缅甸种族灭绝判决具有历史意义，可能产生深远影响
面临制裁的高级军事领导人包括 Myo Htut Hlaing、Myo Min Tun、Myat Thet Oo、Kyaw Soe 和 Kyaw Swar Oo。
米利班德补充说，2021年受到英国制裁的缅甸总统敏昂莱“对所发生的许多暴行负有直接责任”，因为他在2017年种族灭绝事件时担任军方首脑。
他说：“缅甸必须停止持续的违法行为，调查、起诉和惩罚肇事者，并防止此类暴行再次发生。”
米利班德还呼吁“立即暂停敌对行动，以使人道主义援助能够顺利通过，停止对平民的空袭，释放政治犯，并开展对话以达成包容性的政治解决方案”。
外交大臣证实，将通过新的立法，停止向该国供应航空燃料，该国在 1989 年之前一直被称为缅甸。
上周，在国际法院裁定缅甸在 2017 年残酷的军事行动中犯下种族灭绝罪后，他驱逐了缅甸国防武官。
他周一告诉国会议员，英国本周将在联合国安理会提出这个问题，两周后将举行专门会议。
法院周四裁定，“种族灭绝意图是从其所看到的证据中可以得出的唯一合理推论”。
来自世界各地的评审团以九票对六票的多数票作出了这一裁决。国际法院还以多数票裁定缅甸违反了 1948 年《种族灭绝公约》的其他几项规定。
在上周的裁决中，法院确定，在与孟加拉国和孟加拉湾接壤的西部若开邦的清理行动中，约有 10,000 名罗辛亚人被谋杀。缅甸否认了针对它的指控。
报道称，整个村庄被烧毁，妇女和女孩被强奸。
米利班德表示，超过 120 万难民逃离并得到孟加拉国的支持。
种族灭绝期间的缅甸领导人昂山素季于 2021 年被军方废黜。
议员们听说若开军的空袭和暴力事件仍在发生。

title_en: Australia warns tech giants of multibillion-dollar fines for online ‘harm’
title_zh: 澳大利亚警告科技巨头因网络“伤害”而被处以数十亿美元的罚款
summary: New internet safety bill expected to pass this week could impose fines of up to 5 percent of firms' global revenue.
summary_zh: 新的互联网安全法案预计将于本周通过，可能会对企业处以高达全球收入 5% 的罚款。
body_en: Australia warns tech giants of multibillion-dollar fines for online ‘harm’ | Social Media News | Al Jazeera
Share Australia warns tech giants of multibillion-dollar fines for online ‘harm’ on social media
Australia’s government has announced plans to impose hefty fines on tech companies if they fail to pull harmful content off their platforms.
Companies, including Google and Meta, could be hit with fines of up to five percent of their worldwide revenue under a proposed digital duty of care law detailed by the government on Tuesday.

That represents a sizable increase from the previously proposed financial penalty of 109 million Australian dollars ($72.2m), given that some platforms bring in hundreds of billions of dollars in annual revenue.

The new bill, agreed by the centre-left Labor government and the left-leaning Greens in the Senate, would also give individuals the right to sue platforms for enabling wrongdoing. It is expected to be approved in Parliament this week.
“This is seismic reform, this ‌is urgent reform and this is reform we will deliver to Australians in Parliament this week,” Communications Minister Anika Wells told reporters.

The law would replace a patchwork of enforceable codes of conduct drawn up by various online industries, from messaging apps to search engines to AI chatbots, with a single underlying law that forces them to proactively check for and stop harmful user experiences.
Targeted harms include material involving child sexual abuse, nonconsensual fake ⁠nude material, gender-based violence, self-harm promotion and terrorism.
In an effort to curb addictive features, Australians aged 16 or older will also have the option to turn off algorithm-driven feeds.
“It’s about Australia ⁠taking action on the side of parents and children, not foreign-owned tech companies,” Prime Minister Anthony Albanese told Parliament.
“World-leading reform and we are getting it done. Just like we have led the world when it comes to the ⁠under-16s social media ban. This is the next step.”

Though tech firms generally agreed with the government’s aim of improving child protection and ⁠minimising harmful content, most opposed the bill on the grounds ⁠that it gave some discretion to government officials to decide what counted as harmful content.

Even before the government raised the potential fine, industry groups had said the law might encourage platforms to become heavy-handed when deciding what content ‌to take down as they sought to avoid punishment.
Greens Senator Sarah Hanson-Young said the legislation would help stop Australians from being exploited.

“Big tech for far too long has run our lives, dictated what we see in our social media feeds, and pumped our feeds full of addictive, harmful content and thought that they could just get away with it,” she said at a news conference.

澳大利亚政府已宣布计划对未能从其平台上删除有害内容的科技公司处以巨额罚款。
根据政府周二详细列出的拟议数字谨慎法，包括谷歌和 Meta 在内的公司可能会被处以最高相当于其全球收入 5% 的罚款。

鉴于一些平台的年收入高达数千亿美元，这比之前提议的 1.09 亿澳元（7220 万美元）的罚款大幅增加。
这项新法案得到了中左翼工党政府和参议院左倾绿党的同意，该法案还将赋予个人起诉助长不当行为的平台的权利。预计本周将在议会获得批准。
通讯部长阿尼卡·威尔斯 (Anika Wells) 对记者表示：“这是一次重大改革，这是一项紧急改革，也是我们本周将在议会向澳大利亚人提出的改革。”
该法律将取代各种在线行业（从消息应用程序到搜索引擎再到人工智能聊天机器人）制定的可执行行为准则，并用单一的基本法律迫使它们主动检查并阻止有害的用户体验。
有针对性的伤害包括涉及儿童性虐待的材料、未经同意的假冒裸体材料、基于性别的暴力、宣扬自残和恐怖主义。
为了遏制令人上瘾的功能，16 岁或以上的澳大利亚人还可以选择关闭算法驱动的源。
“这是澳大利亚为父母和孩子而不是外资科技公司采取行动，”总理安东尼·阿尔巴内斯告诉议会。
“世界领先的改革，我们正在完成它。就像我们在 16 岁以下社交媒体禁令方面领先世界一样。这是下一步。”
尽管科技公司普遍同意政府改善儿童保护和尽量减少有害内容的目标，但大多数公司反对该法案，因为它赋予政府官员一定的自由裁量权来决定什么算作有害内容。
甚至在政府提高潜在罚款之前，行业组织就表示，该法律可能会鼓励平台在决定删除哪些内容时变得严厉，因为他们试图避免受到惩罚。
绿党参议员莎拉·汉森-杨表示，这项立法将有助于阻止澳大利亚人受到剥削。
她在新闻发布会上表示：“长期以来，大型科技已经左右了我们的生活，决定了我们在社交媒体中看到的内容，并在我们的社交媒体中注入了充满令人上瘾、有害的内容，并认为他们可以侥幸逃脱惩罚。”

title_en: Bangladesh's ex-PM Sheikh Hasina says she plans to return on 16 December
title_zh: 孟加拉国前总理谢赫·哈西娜表示她计划于 12 月 16 日回国
summary: Hasina has spoken several times of her desire to return, but this is the first time she has set a date.
summary_zh: 哈西娜曾多次表达过回国的愿望，但这是她第一次确定日期。
body_en: Bangladesh's former prime minister Sheikh Hasina has said she plans to return home on 16 December, more than two years after a popular uprising forced her from power.
Hasina, who has lived in exile in Delhi since August 2024, has asked the Bangladeshi government to fly her back to Dhaka, her spokesperson said.
The announcement comes amid renewed unrest in Bangladesh, where supporters of her Awami League party have staged protests despite a ban on its activities.

But it's unclear how Hasina will return. Last year, a Bangladeshi court sentenced her to death in absentia for crimes against humanity over a deadly crackdown on student-led protests that ended her 15-year rule . She denies the charges.
Bangladesh's state minister for foreign affairs Humayun Kabir dismissed the prospect of Hasina returning on her own terms.
"Sheikh Hasina will not be able to return to the country as an ordinary commercial passenger; she will be brought back in handcuffs," he told a press briefing on Tuesday.
Kabir also accused Hasina and Delhi of fomenting recent unrest in Bangladesh, alleging that they were backing "terrorist activities" in the country.

India's foreign ministry did not immediately respond to a ​request for comment. In April, ​the ministry said it was ⁠examining Bangladesh's request to extradite her and that it wanted to "engage constructively with the new government and further strengthen bilateral ties".
Hasina fled to India on 5 August 2024 as tens of thousands of protesters descended on Dhaka, and crowds stormed her official residence.

What began as student protests against quotas in government jobs turned into a mass uprising against her government following a deadly crackdown on demonstrators. The UN estimates that up to 1,400 people were killed during the unrest.
On Tuesday, Hasina's spokesperson Syed Mozammel Ali accused Bangladeshi authorities of forcing her into exile in violation of the country's constitution.

"Since Sheikh Hasina was flown to India on a Bangladesh aircraft on 5 August 2024, she now calls upon the government to arrange for her air transport from Delhi back to Dhaka," he said in a statement.

The choice of date is significant. Bangladesh celebrates Victory Day on 16 December, marking the end of its 1971 war of independence from Pakistan. Hasina's father, Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, led the country's independence movement.

Abu Obaidha Arin, an aide to Hasina, described her decision as "deeply symbolic". "We firmly believe that she will celebrate this historic day among her people," he said, expressing confidence that she would once again lead Bangladesh.
Hasina's announcement - and Dhaka's sharp response to it - come at a time when the ousted leader is seeking to reassert her political relevance from exile.
The Awami League was banned from political activities in May last year under the interim government led by Nobel Peace Prize laureate Muhammad Yunus, which took charge after Hasina's ouster.

The party was subsequently barred from contesting February's general election, which brought its long-time rival, the Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP), to power, with Tarique Rahman becoming prime minister.
But the ban has not put an end to street protests by Awami League supporters, who have also called for nationwide shutdowns demanding Hasina's return.
Hasina, meanwhile, has repeatedly spoken of her desire to return to Bangladesh, even as she has acknowledged the risks of doing so.

"I know that they may put me in jail or they may kill me, anything may happen, but still I have to go back," she told a gathering of journalists in Delhi over an audio link in August, on the second anniversary of her ouster.
body_zh: 孟加拉国前总理谢赫·哈西娜表示，她计划于 12 月 16 日回国，距离一场民众起义迫使她下台已有两年多了。
哈西娜的发言人表示，哈西娜自 2024 年 8 月以来一直流亡在德里，她已要求孟加拉国政府将她飞回达卡。
这一消息发布之际，孟加拉国再次出现骚乱，尽管该党的活动被禁止，但其人民联盟党的支持者仍举行抗议活动。
但目前还不清楚哈西娜将如何回归。去年，孟加拉国一家法院因对学生领导的抗议活动进行致命镇压而以反人类罪缺席判处她死刑，结束了她15年的统治。她否认这些指控。
孟加拉国外交部长胡马云·卡比尔驳回了哈西娜按自己意愿回国的可能性。
“谢赫·哈西娜将无法作为普通商业乘客返回该国；她将被戴上手铐带回来，”他在周二的新闻发布会上说。
卡比尔还指责哈西娜和德里煽动孟加拉国最近的骚乱，声称他们支持该国的“恐怖活动”。
印度外交部没有立即回应置评请求。今年四月，该部表示正在审查孟加拉国引渡她的请求，并希望“与新政府进行建设性接触，进一步加强双边关系”。
2024 年 8 月 5 日，数万名抗议者涌入达卡，人群冲进她的官邸，哈西娜逃往印度。
最初是学生反对政府工作配额的抗议活动，在对示威者进行致命镇压后，演变成了反对政府的大规模起义。联合国估计，骚乱期间有多达 1,400 人死亡。
周二，哈西娜的发言人赛义德·莫扎梅尔·阿里指责孟加拉国当局强迫她流亡，违反了该国宪法。
他在一份声明中表示：“自从谢赫·哈西娜于 2024 年 8 月 5 日乘坐孟加拉国飞机飞往印度后，她现在呼吁政府安排她从德里返回达卡的航空运输。”
日期的选择很重要。孟加拉国于 12 月 16 日庆祝胜利日，标志着 1971 年脱离巴基斯坦的独立战争的结束。哈西娜的父亲谢赫·穆吉布·拉赫曼领导了该国的独立运动。
哈西娜的助手阿布·奥拜达·阿林 (Abu Obaidha Arin) 形容她的决定“具有深刻的象征意义”。他说：“我们坚信她将与她的人民一起庆祝这一历史性的一天”，并表示相信她将再次领导孟加拉国。
哈西娜的宣布以及达卡对此作出的尖锐回应之际，这位被罢黜的领导人正在寻求重新确立其流亡后的政治影响力。
去年5月，诺贝尔和平奖获得者穆罕默德·尤努斯领导的临时政府在哈西娜下台后上台，人民联盟被禁止参与政治活动。
该党随后被禁止参加二月份的大选，这使得其长期竞争对手孟加拉国民族主义党（BNP）上台，塔里克·拉赫曼（Tarique Rahman）成为总理。
但禁令并没有结束人民联盟支持者的街头抗议，他们还呼吁全国范围内关闭，要求哈西娜回归。
与此同时，哈西娜多次表示她希望返回孟加拉国，尽管她承认这样做的风险。
“我知道他们可能会把我关进监狱，或者杀掉我，任何事情都可能发生，但我仍然必须回去，”八月，在她下台两周年之际，她通过音频链接在德里的一次记者聚会上说道。

title_en: India's 'cockroach' party leader says he was stopped from flying to UK
title_zh: 印度“蟑螂”党领袖称他被阻止飞往英国
summary: Saurav Das said that immigration authorities at Delhi airport told him that his passport had been "flagged".
summary_zh: 绍拉夫·达斯说，德里机场的移民当局告诉他，他的护照已被“标记”。
body_en: Saurav Das: Cockroach Janta Party leader says he was stopped from flying to UK for Oxford event - BBC News
A leader of India's "cockroach" party has said that immigration officials at Delhi airport stopped him from flying to the UK, where he was set to attend a series of events.
Saurav Das said he was supposed to board a flight on Tuesday at 01:00 local time (19:30 GMT on Monday) but was told by immigration officers that his passport had been "flagged".
It is not clear yet why Das's passport was flagged. The BBC has reached out to the federal home ministry, Delhi police and airport officials for comment.
Das, who rose to prominence in India earlier this year after Gen Z-led protests , said that he had been invited by the Oxford Union to speak about the movement.
He said that he was also scheduled to speak at other universities in Cambridge and Edinburgh.
"Indian students put their heart and soul to organise the events but this anti-intellectual [government] was scared of me going to these prestigious institutions," he wrote on X.
A federal home ministry spokesperson directed the BBC to airport authorities and the Delhi police for comment on Das's allegations.
Ratna Singh, another leader of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), said in a post on X that she and Das had been invited by the Oxford Union but that her visa had been rejected a few days ago.

"The manner in which Saurav was not allowed to board today raises deeply troubling questions about the state of freedom of expression and the space being allowed for young voices in this country," she wrote.
Das, a former journalist, became one of the faces of the CJP - a Gen Z-led movement that began as satire but has since emerged as a youth-led pressure group.
In July, protests spearheaded by the CJP over exam paper leaks led to the resignation of India's Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan .

In October, CJP leaders including Das were among thousands of people detained by the police for trying to hold protests demanding the resignation of India's Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over alleged irregularities in electoral rolls. Kumar and the Election Commission have denied wrongdoing.
The same month, Das and Ashutosh Ranka, another CJP leader, were jailed for seven days after being arrested for trespassing at a banned protest site in Delhi.

Abhijeet Dipke, the founder of CJP, wrote on X that if Das "had looted a bank or committed financial fraud", he may have been allowed to fly to London, referring to billionaire bank-loan defaulters who have left India.
There have been other instances in recent years of people being prevented from boarding flights.
In September 2025, Bhanu Tatak, an environmental and anti-dam activist from India's north-eastern Arunachal Pradesh state, was stopped from boarding a flight to Dublin.

In March 2022, Rana Ayyub, an investigative journalist and outspoken critic of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's government, was also stopped from boarding a flight to London at the Mumbai airport. She was due to speak at different events on media freedom and the targeting of journalists.
body_zh: 绍拉夫·达斯：蟑螂简塔党领导人表示，他被阻止飞往英国参加牛津活动 - BBC 新闻
印度“蟑螂”党的一名领导人表示，德里机场的移民官员阻止他飞往英国，他原定要去英国参加一系列活动。
萨乌拉夫·达斯 (Saurav Das) 表示，他原定于当地时间周二 01:00（格林威治标准时间周一 19:30）登机，但移民官员告诉他，他的护照已被“标记”。
目前尚不清楚达斯的护照为何被标记。 BBC 已联系联邦内政部、德里警方和机场官员征求评论。
达斯今年早些时候在 Z 世代领导的抗议活动后在印度声名鹊起，他表示，牛津联盟邀请他就这场运动发表演讲。
他说，他还计划在剑桥和爱丁堡的其他大学发表演讲。
“印度学生全心全意地组织这些活动，但这个反知识分子（政府）害怕我去这些享有盛誉的机构，”他在 X 上写道。
联邦内政部发言人指示 BBC 联系机场当局和德里警方，请其对达斯的指控发表评论。
蟑螂简塔党（CJP）的另一位领导人拉特纳·辛格（Ratna Singh）在X上发帖称，她和达斯已受到牛津联盟的邀请，但她的签证几天前被拒绝。
她写道：“索拉夫今天不被允许登机的方式引发了令人深感不安的问题，即这个国家的言论自由状况和年轻人的声音空间。”
达斯曾是一名记者，后来成为 CJP 的代表人物之一。CJP 是 Z 世代领导的运动，一开始只是讽刺，后来发展成为一个由年轻人领导的压力团体。
7 月，印度人民党带头抗议试卷泄露，导致印度教育部长达门德拉·普拉丹 (Dharmendra Pradhan) 辞职。
10月，包括达斯在内的数千名人民党领导人因试图举行抗议活动，要求印度首席选举专员贾内什·库马尔因选举名册涉嫌违规行为而辞职而被警方拘留。库马尔和选举委员会否认有不当行为。
同月，达斯和另一位 CJP 领导人阿舒托什·兰卡 (Ashutosh Ranka) 因侵入德里一个被禁止的抗议地点被捕后被监禁 7 天。
CJP 创始人阿比吉特·迪普克 (Abhijeet Dipke) 在 X 上写道，如果达斯“抢劫了一家银行或实施了金融欺诈”，他可能会被允许飞往伦敦，他指的是已经离开印度的亿万富翁银行贷款违约者。
近年来还发生过其他人们被阻止登机的情况。
2025 年 9 月，来自印度东北部阿鲁纳恰尔邦的环保和反水坝活动人士巴努·塔塔克 (Bhanu Tatak) 在登上飞往都柏林的航班时被拦截。
2022 年 3 月，调查记者兼总理纳伦德拉·莫迪政府的直言不讳的批评者拉纳·阿尤布 (Rana Ayyub) 在孟买机场也被阻止登上飞往伦敦的航班。她将在不同的活动中就媒体自由和针对记者的问题发表讲话。

title_en: Trump faces backlash after saying he 'convinced' Nvidia to reinstate CEO Jensen Huang
title_zh: 特朗普在表示“说服”英伟达恢复首席执行官黄仁勋后面临强烈反对
summary: Nvidia had come under pressure from President Trump to reappoint Huang, whose comeback helped add $1tn to the company's stock value.
summary_zh: 英伟达面临特朗普总统的压力，要求重新任命黄仁勋，黄仁勋的回归帮助该公司的股价增加了 1 万亿美元。
body_en: Trump faces backlash after he 'convinced' Nvidia to reinstate Jensen Huang - BBC News
By Bernd Debusmann Jr , White House reporter and Kali Hays , Technology reporter , Reporting from San Francisco

Nvidia has reinstated CEO Jensen Huang just days after rejecting his offer to return to the AI chipmaker - and less than two weeks after he was forced to resign over a reported affair with a suspected Chinese spy.
The company came under pressure by Donald Trump to reappoint Huang - and on Monday, the US president said he "made the deal" to "convince" the tech giant's board to bring him back.
But now both Trump and Nvidia are facing bipartisan backlash from lawmakers, just as Huang is due to testify before Congress next week.
The CEO's comeback helped end a week-long losing streak in US stocks that left the S&P 500 in correction territory, and added nearly $1 trillion to Nvidia's market value.
Stock prices for Nvidia fell sharply after Huang stepped down, but jumped by 31% after he was reappointed on Monday - adding about $1tn to the company's market value.
But Nvidia's closing price was still down slightly from its Friday morning opening price.
As Asian stock markets opened, Nvidia racked up more gains and helped lift other share prices across the tech sector.
Asia markets jump as Nvidia boss Jensen Huang reinstated after spy scandal

Board Chairman Harvey C Jones said in a statement earlier in the day: "The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead Nvidia, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers."
The board said it had received input from senior levels of the US government and was confident that Huang's reinstatement posed no national security risk.
It was only last Tuesday that the board explicitly said it did not intend to reinstate him.
Huang resigned from Nvidia on 12 November following reports of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman, Alice Huang, who was alleged to have ties to Chinese intelligence.
On Monday, the US Commerce Department announced it was preparing to blacklist Megaspeed, the Singapore-based Nvidia customer where Alice Huang was CEO.

In a brief interview with CNBC on Monday, Trump said he had spoken to Nvidia's board of directors and "convinced" them to bring back Huang. Trump praised the Nvidia board for acting "really responsibly" in reinstating the CEO.
"They did ask for assurance on the national security threat," Trump said. "And we gave them assurances at least with everything we know. And we know a lot."
"People say, is it a threat to have him? No, it's a threat to lose him," the president added.
The president was asked whether Nvidia stock losses after Huang resigned last week had influenced his decision to personally intervene.
The rise and fall and rise again of Jensen Huang
body_zh: 特朗普“说服”英伟达恢复黄仁勋职位后面临强烈反对 - BBC 新闻
作者：Bernd Debusmann Jr，白宫记者和 Kali Hays，科技记者，旧金山报道
英伟达 (Nvidia) 恢复了首席执行官黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 的职位，就在几天前，黄仁勋拒绝了他重返这家人工智能芯片制造商的提议，而不到两周前，他因涉嫌与一名中国间谍嫌疑人有染而被迫辞职。
该公司面临唐纳德·特朗普的压力，要求重新任命黄仁勋，而周一，这位美国总统表示，他“达成协议”是为了“说服”这家科技巨头的董事会让他重新任命。
但现在特朗普和英伟达都面临着立法者两党的强烈反对，黄仁勋将于下周在国会作证。
这位首席执行官的复出帮助结束了美国股市长达一周的连续下跌，导致标准普尔 500 指数进入回调区间，并使英伟达的市值增加了近 1 万亿美元。
黄仁勋下台后，英伟达股价大幅下跌，但周一他重新任命后，该公司股价上涨了 31%，该公司市值增加了约 1 万亿美元。
但英伟达的收盘价仍较周五上午开盘价小幅下跌。
随着亚洲股市开盘，英伟达股价上涨，并帮助提振了科技行业的其他股价。
英伟达老板黄仁勋在间谍丑闻后复职，亚洲股市上涨
董事会主席 Harvey C Jones 当天早些时候在一份声明中表示：“董事会认为 Jensen 是领导 Nvidia 的合适人选，他的复职符合我们股东、员工、合作伙伴和客户的最佳利益。”
该委员会表示，已收到美国政府高层的意见，并相信黄的复职不会构成国家安全风险。
直到上周二，董事会才明确表示不打算恢复他的职位。
黄先生于 11 月 12 日从 Nvidia 辞职，此前有报道称黄先生有婚外情，其中包括与一名名叫 Alice Huang 的女性的婚外情，据称她与中国情报部门有联系。
周一，美国商务部宣布准备将总部位于新加坡的 Nvidia 客户 Megaspeed 列入黑名单，Alice Huang 是该公司的首席执行官。
特朗普周一在接受 CNBC 简短采访时表示，他已经与英伟达董事会进行了交谈，并“说服”他们让黄仁勋回归。特朗普称赞英伟达董事会在恢复首席执行官职务方面表现得“非常负责任”。
特朗普说：“他们确实要求就国家安全威胁做出保证。” “我们至少用我们所知道的一切向他们保证。而且我们知道很多。”
“人们说，拥有他是一种威胁吗？不，这是失去他的威胁，”总统补充道。
总统被问及黄上周辞职后英伟达股票下跌是否影响了他亲自干预的决定。

title_en: UN chief calls for world to agree on AI oversight within a year
title_zh: 联合国秘书长呼吁世界在一年内就人工智能监管达成一致
summary: Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has become increasingly vocal about AI as end of term nears.
summary_zh: 随着任期临近，秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯对人工智能的呼声越来越高。
body_en: UN chief calls for world to agree on AI oversight within a year | Technology News | Al Jazeera
Share UN chief calls for world to agree on AI oversight within a year on social media
United Nations Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has called for measures to better manage the risks posed by artificial intelligence (AI) during a conference in Barbados.

“Today I call for member states to coordinate efforts and to develop within the next year a globally inclusive and principles-based multilateral framework for AI risk management, backed by independent and credible oversight,” Guterres said Monday.
list of 3 items list 1 of 3 Why have UN efforts to regulate ‘killer robots’ stalled?
list 2 of 3 Can we build a more ethical AI future?
list 3 of 3 Mamdani blasts AI-reliant stock market after Jensen Huang’s return

Guterres, who is approaching the end of his term due in December, has become increasingly vocal about the need for safety measures around advanced technology to avoid a future in which “ killer robots ” are a reality.
Guterres said Monday at the Bridgetown Special Summit on AI Safety that “when one looks at different other institutions of global governance … they correspond to the reality of the world in 1945”.
“It’s clear that institutions need to be reformed in order to adapt themselves to the realities of today’s world,” he said.
“That applies to the UN, and that applies to the international financial architecture, that applies to the world trade system.”

Guterres said that he would advise his successor, due to take office in the new year but yet to be selected, that properly controlling AI would be necessary for “humanity to maintain control of our world”.
International regulation of AI appears distant as the technology’s superpowers, the United States and China, continue to seek the upper hand in research and development breakthroughs.
Nonetheless, Guterres said that a starting point could be for countries to agree on shared safety measures, a testing regime and basic requirements for independent oversight.
In September, Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and SpaceX chief Elon Musk called for a slowdown in the development of AI.
Others, like Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg, want to move full steam ahead.
Regulators in the US, where AI development has proceeded at the fastest pace, appear unlikely to immediately intervene.
In September, US President Donald Trump hosted a group of American tech executives who agreed to abide by a voluntary code of conduct on AI safety.
body_zh: 联合国秘书长呼吁世界在一年内就人工智能监管达成一致 |科技新闻|半岛电视台
联合国秘书长呼吁世界在一年内就社交媒体上的人工智能监管达成一致
联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯在巴巴多斯举行的一次会议上呼吁采取措施更好地管理人工智能（AI）带来的风险。
古特雷斯周一表示：“今天，我呼吁成员国协调努力，在明年内制定一个全球包容性、基于原则的人工智能风险管理多边框架，并得到独立和可信监督的支持。”
共 3 项清单 第 1 项（共 3 项） 为什么联合国监管“杀手机器人”的努力陷入停滞？
列表 2（共 3） 我们能否打造一个更加道德的人工智能未来？
list 3 of 3 Mamdani 在黄仁勋回归后抨击依赖人工智能的股市
古特雷斯的任期即将于 12 月结束，他越来越明确地表示需要围绕先进技术采取安全措施，以避免“杀手机器人”成为现实。
古特雷斯周一在布里奇敦人工智能安全特别峰会上表示，“当人们审视其他不同的全球治理机构时……它们符合 1945 年世界的现实”。
“很明显，机构需要进行改革，以适应当今世界的现实，”他说。
“这适用于联合国，适用于国际金融架构，适用于世界贸易体系。”
古特雷斯表示，他将建议将于新年上任但尚未选定的继任者，适当控制人工智能对于“人类维持对世界的控制”是必要的。
随着人工智能技术超级大国美国和中国继续在研发突破方面寻求优势，对人工智能的国际监管似乎遥不可及。
尽管如此，古特雷斯表示，起点可能是各国就共同安全措施、测试制度和独立监督的基本要求达成一致。
9 月，Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei)、OpenAI 首席执行官萨姆·奥尔特曼 (Sam Altman) 和 SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 呼吁放慢人工智能的发展速度。
其他人，如英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋和 Meta 首席执行官马克·扎克伯格，则希望全力推进。
人工智能发展速度最快的美国监管机构似乎不太可能立即干预。
9 月，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普接待了一群美国科技高管，他们同意遵守人工智能安全自愿行为准则。

title_en: King Charles and Elton John pay tribute to Australian music legend Molly Meldrum
title_zh: 查尔斯国王和埃尔顿·约翰向澳大利亚音乐传奇人物莫莉·梅尔德鲁姆致敬
summary: The promoter and broadcaster helped define the music tastes of Australians for decades.

body_en: Molly Meldrum: King Charles and Elton John pay tribute to Australian music legend - BBC News
King Charles and Elton John have paid tribute to Australian music industry legend Molly Meldrum, who died aged 83 after a long illness.
Meldrum's family said he "passed away peacefully" at a hospital in Melbourne in the early hours of Monday morning.
The music promoter and broadcaster, born Ian Alexander Meldrum, helped define the nation's music tastes for decades, championing local artists like INXS and Kylie Minogue and global acts like Abba.
Known for his chaotic demeanour and trademark Stetson hat, he interviewed an array of stars, with the king on Monday calling him "a true giant of the music industry".

Born in Victoria in 1943, Meldrum displayed a love of music from an early age and went on to host the Australian Broadcasting Corporation's music television programme Countdown, and later a segment on variety show Hey Hey, It's Saturday.
Meldrum in 2014 became the first person who was not a recording artist to be inducted into the Australian Recording Industry Association (Aria) Hall of Fame.
Meldrum lived with an acquired brain injury after falling from a ladder in 2011.
"Affectionately dubbed 'the Guru', Molly was the heartbeat, the champion and the spirit of Australian music," a statement from Meldrum's family said.
Among his most famous interviews was a 1977 sit-down with King Charles, in which Meldrum could not calm his jitters.
He stumbled over his lines, declaring: "Your Royal Highness... Oh, oh, I'm sweating like a pig".

King Charles reflected on the infamous interview for Countdown's 40th anniversary special , saying: "There is an old showbusiness saying which warns never to work with animals or children. But nobody prepared me for Molly Meldrum".
On Monday, an aide to the King said he had been "deeply saddened" to hear of Meldrum's death.

"His Majesty's interview with Molly is a moment he and many others will never forget - he hopes that interview will once again raise a few smiles as Australians honour Molly's legacy as a true giant of the music industry."
Elton John - a friend and regular interviewee - paid tribute to him as "an Australian legend and an institution", while pop star Kylie Minogue said she would be turning up the music in his honour.
"As a kid, I watched Molly Meldrum on Countdown every single weekend, in awe of the show and the magic it brought to our little TV in the lounge room."
"He championed so many Aussie artists and welcomed international artists to Australia in his own wonderful and inimitable way. I'm so grateful for his unwavering love and support."

Australia's Arts Minister Tony Burke said the country had lost an icon: "One of his greatest legacies will be the generations of Australians who grew up with his unmistakable enthusiasm and love of music."
body_zh: 莫莉·梅尔德鲁姆：查尔斯国王和埃尔顿·约翰向澳大利亚音乐传奇人物致敬 - BBC 新闻
查尔斯国王和埃尔顿·约翰向澳大利亚音乐界传奇人物莫莉·梅尔德鲁姆致敬，莫莉·梅尔德鲁姆因长期患病去世，享年 83 岁。
梅尔德鲁姆的家人表示，他于周一凌晨在墨尔本的一家医院“平静地去世”。
这位音乐推广人和广播员原名伊恩·亚历山大·梅尔德鲁姆 (Ian Alexander Meldrum)，几十年来帮助定义了这个国家的音乐品味，支持 INXS 和凯莉·米洛 (Kylie Minogue) 等当地艺术家以及 Abba 等全球艺人。
他以其混乱的举止和标志性的斯泰森帽而闻名，他采访了众多明星，国王周一称他为“音乐界真正的巨人”。
梅尔德鲁姆1943年出生于维多利亚州，从小就表现出对音乐的热爱，后来主持了澳大利亚广播公司的音乐电视节目《倒计时》，后来又在综艺节目《嘿嘿，星期六了》中担任节目主持人。
2014年，梅尔德鲁姆成为第一个入选澳大利亚唱片工业协会（Aria）名人堂的非唱片艺术家。
2011 年，梅尔德鲁姆从梯子上摔下来，导致脑部受伤。
梅尔德鲁姆的家人在一份声明中说：“莫莉被亲切地称为‘大师’，她是澳大利亚音乐的心跳、冠军和精神。”
他最著名的采访之一是 1977 年与查尔斯国王的一次会面，在这次采访中，梅尔德鲁姆无法平息自己的紧张情绪。
他结结巴巴地说：“殿下……噢，噢，我汗如猪”。
查尔斯国王回顾了 Countdown 40 周年纪念特辑中那次臭名昭著的采访，他说：“演艺界有一句古老的谚语，警告永远不要与动物或儿童一起工作。但没有人让我为莫莉·梅尔德鲁姆做好准备”。
周一，国王的一名助手表示，听到梅尔德鲁姆的死讯，他“深感悲痛”。
“陛下对莫莉的采访是他和许多其他人永远不会忘记的时刻 - 他希望这次采访能够再次引起一些微笑，因为澳大利亚人尊重莫莉作为音乐行业真正巨人的遗产。”
埃尔顿·约翰（Elton John）——他的朋友和经常接受采访的人——向他致敬，称其为“澳大利亚的传奇人物和风云人物”，而流行歌星凯莉·米洛（Kylie Minogue）则表示，她将播放音乐以纪念他。
“小时候，我每个周末都会观看莫莉·梅尔德鲁姆 (Molly Meldrum) 的《倒计时》节目，我对这个节目以及它为我们休息室的小电视带来的魔力感到敬畏。”
“他支持如此多的澳大利亚艺术家，并以他自己美妙而独特的方式欢迎国际艺术家来到澳大利亚。我非常感谢他坚定不移的爱和支持。”
澳大利亚艺术部长托尼·伯克表示，这个国家失去了一位偶像：“他最伟大的遗产之一将是伴随着他对音乐的热情和热爱长大的几代澳大利亚人。”
